ideas.label: Pawn Chain / Locked Centre
ideas.principle: Attack the pawn chain at its support
ideas.summary: In a locked center, pawn chains determine space, breaks, and piece routes. Attack the base or undermine the head rather than pushing without a target.

ideas.label: Pawn Chain / Locked Centre
ideas.principle: Coordinate the wing attack with the chain
ideas.summary: A closed center gives time to reroute pieces toward the wing where the chain points. Prepare the pawn lever that opens lines for those pieces while slowing the opponent's lever.
games: Naidon, Pietro Weber vs Born, Ary 2026 (C00)
Eslava Cordoba, Salome vs Rodriguez Patino, Santiago 2026 (C00)

ideas.label: Pawn Chain / Locked Centre
ideas.principle: Choose the lever by resulting lines
ideas.summary: When one lever attacks the front pawn and another attacks the base, compare which exchange opens the useful diagonal or file. A flank pawn push can be correct if it fixes the defender or removes support from the entire chain.
